visualCharacteristics.structure: single horizontal strip under a thin top rule: 60px round photo on the left, name heading over an uppercase roles line, row of three social icon links right-aligned on desktop; icons wrap below on tablet/mobile

contentPattern: One row per author, 2 cells: photo | text (name as heading, roles line e.g. 'Skater, Writer', social links as plain text links labelled Facebook / Twitter / Instagram, rendered as inline SVG icon links with the network name kept as visually hidden text)
